Game Overview

At its heart, Get Ready With Me Summer Picnic is a dress up game about join Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet in a vibrant summer adventure. Help these Rainbow high schoolers prepare for their picnic, choosing outfits and accessories to express their unique styles. Embrace creativity and sartorial fun as you assist them in crafting the perfect look for their sunny getaway.
